footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Jefferson Capital: after $18.6M of preferred dividends. No per-share figures were reported for the prior year.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 41.5% to $613M in 2025. Operating income rose 43.7% to $316M, a 51.6% margin.
Net income rose 31.4% to $169M, or $0.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $269M and free cash flow $268M, versus $162M; Jefferson Capital returned $63.5M through dividends.
sources: Jefferson Capital, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
